besluite.rede: Two short subjectless imperatives sharing one 'moenie' frame read cleanly without a comma, and the AWS rule applies to clauses with their own subject, so the change is not required and adds nothing.

besluite.fout: The adverbial word group 'end aan end' is written as separate words in the AWS (like 'kop aan kop', 'hand aan hand'); hyphens belong only in attributive compounds.
